notes: Client needs an AI voice assistant for his dental clinic website to answer appointments 24/7.
summary: Prospective client operates a 3-branch dental clinic. Seeking 24/7 automated voice answering on footer of his website to book appointments directly into Google Calendar. High purchase intent.

transcript.text: Hi there! I am Alex from Apex Digital. We build high-converting websites and AI voice agents that 3x sales. Are you looking to build a new website or automate your lead calls?
Hello, we run a dental clinic with 3 branches and we miss a lot of patient calls after 6 PM. We need an AI agent for our website.

That is exactly what we specialize in! Our voice agent sits in the footer of your website and answers patient inquiries, checks available slots, and books appointments 24/7. What monthly patient inquiry volume are you handling right now?
Around 400 to 500 inquiries a month. Our budget is around $1500 to $2500.
That budget fits our Growth Package perfectly. It includes multi-location calendar routing and instant SMS/email confirmations. Would tomorrow at 4 PM work for a 15-minute live screen demo?
Yes, tomorrow at 4 PM is great. My name is Tariq Mahmood, email is tariq.mahmood@example.com and phone is +92 300 8765432.
Thank you Tariq! Your consultation is locked in. I've sent the complete transcript and requirements summary to our team and your inbox.
